summary: Stick strictly to US history and US-adjacent lore (Wild West, WWII US military); non-US topics perform disastrously.
Prioritize storytelling with clear narrative stakes (e.g., lost treasure, daring rescue missions) to sustain 3+ minute watch times.
Avoid vague clickbait titles; ensure titles clearly state the historical subject to prevent high early drop-off.
Deliver on the title premise within the first 10 seconds of the video to fix zero-retention bounces.
Target 19th and 20th century American historical events where viewer demand and retention peak.
Discontinue modern geopolitics and foreign medieval history until a core US history audience is established.
